official_message: ContinueButton size_flags_horizontal must be Expand Fill
solver_message:
The task is complete. Summary of what was done:

## Created Files

**`res://scenes/ui/battle_over_panel.tscn`** — Panel UI scene with:
- Root `Panel` named `BattleOverPanel` with `process_mode = 3` (Always) and full-rect anchors (`anchors_preset = 15`, stretching to entire window)
- `theme_override_styles/panel` set to a `StyleBoxFlat` with `bg_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.34902)`
- A centered `VBoxContainer` (center anchor preset, offsets −20/−20/20/20, `alignment = 1`)
- Inside it:
  - `Label` (unique name) — text `"Victorious!"`, centered horizontal (`1`) and vertical (`1`) alignment, `LabelSettings` with `font_size = 24`
  - `ContinueButton` (unique name) — `custom_minimum_size (50, 16)`, `size_flags_horizontal = 3` (expand fill), text `"Awesome!"`
  - `RestartButton` (unique name) — same size/flags, text `"Restart"`

**`res://scenes/ui/battle_over_panel.gd`** — Script with:
- `class_name BattleOverPanel`, `extends Panel`
- `enum Type {WIN, LOSE}`
- `%Label`, `%ContinueButton`, `%RestartButton` bindings via `@onready`
- `_ready()` connects `ContinueButton` → `get_tree().quit`, `RestartButton` → `get_tree().reload_current_scene`, and `Events.battle_over_screen_requested` → `show_screen`
- `show_screen(text, type)` updates label text, shows `ContinueButton` only for `WIN`, `RestartButton` only for `LOSE`, calls `show()`, and pauses the tree

## Verification
- ✅ Headless project import — no errors
- ✅ Rendered frame via `--write-movie` — panel displays fullscreen with centered dark box and visible label/buttons
- ✅ Functional test: enum values, node bindings, both button connections, and `show_screen` behavior verified for both WIN and LOSE (label updates, correct button visibility, `paused = true`)
- ✅ End-to-end test with the real `Events` autoload: emitting `battle_over_screen_requested` correctly drives the panel in game mode
- ✅ All temporary test artifacts removed; `main.tscn` restored to its original state
